entities.summary: Gelu Voican-Voiculescu is a Romanian politician and former dissident who served as deputy prime minister in the provisional government of Romania (1989–1990). He was also a senator of Buzău in the 1990-1992 legislature, elected on the lists of the National Salvation Front, as well as ambassador to Tunisia and Morocco.
